title: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Risk Assessment of Traffic Analysis Attacks on Cloud LLM Services
abstract: arXiv:2609.31877v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cloud-based Large language model (LLM) services create a network-level traffic side channel that can expose model, prompt, and task behavior despite encryption. From packet sizes, directions, timing, and burst structure alone, a passive local observer can infer the serving model, the user's prompt category, and the task executed by a collaborative multi-agent system. Yet current evidence is fragmented across separate datasets and settings, limiting reproducibility and comparison. We present, to our knowledge, the first unified measurement study and public benchmark of encrypted LLM traffic across both user--LLM and multi-agent executions. The large-scale benchmark contains 60,000 user--LLM interactions across 10 models and 6 prompt categories, plus 2,838 multi-agent executions covering 10 task categories and two coordination topologies. translated_title: 面向云LLM服务的流量分析攻击大规模基准与风险评估
translated_abstract: 基于云的大型语言模型（LLM）服务会形成网络层面的流量侧信道，即使在加密状态下也可能暴露模型、提示词和任务行为。仅凭数据包的大小、方向、时序和突发结构，一个被动的本地观察者就能推断出所使用的服务模型、用户的提示词类别，以及协作式多智能体系统所执行的任务。然而，目前的证据分散于各自独立的数据集和实验设置中，限制了可重复性和可比较性。据我们所知，本研究提出了首个统一的加密LLM流量测量研究与公开基准，同时涵盖用户-LLM交互和多智能体执行场景。该大规模基准包含覆盖10个模型和6个提示词类别的60,000次用户-LLM交互，以及覆盖10个任务类别和两种协调拓扑的2,838次多智能体执行。仅使用加密的数据包元数据，我们评估了流量分析攻击的风险……
tldr: 该论文构建了首个统一的加密LLM流量公开基准（含60,000次用户-LLM交互和2,838次多智能体执行），系统评估了攻击者仅凭加密数据包元数据即可推断所服务模型、提示词类别和任务行为的流量分析攻击风险。
